summary: Decrements the entry count of a fixed-size array of DWORD pairs, shifts the remaining pairs one slot toward the front, then reports emptiness through ArithmeticComparison_5660 using a comparison base located at parent-object + 13004.

operations.description: If the entry count this[15] (this+0x3C) is not greater than 0, skip the decrement and shift and jump straight to status reporting.
Decrement the entry count: this[15] = this[15] - 1 (this+0x3C).

Shift every remaining DWORD pair one slot toward the front while the copy index is below the new count: slot i type/value (this+0x40 / this+0x44) are overwritten with slot i+1 type/value (this+0x48 / this+0x4C onward).
Compute the status-report base pointer as the parent object at (this+0x0) advanced by 13004 bytes.
Call ArithmeticComparison_5660 with that base pointer and flag 0 when the count is <= 0 (empty) or 1 when the count is > 0 (has entries).
Return the result of the ArithmeticComparison_5660 call.

clean_pseudocode: for (i = 0; i < this[15]; i++) { slot[i].type = slot[i+1].type; slot[i].value = slot[i+1].value; }
